dance.faq: Smalltown Boy AI video: your questions answered
dance.q1: How do I make a Smalltown Boy AI video from my photos?
dance.a1: Upload two photos, one per role. A takes the opening close-up and B dances behind. Sign in, choose a resolution and review the credit cost before generating. Follow progress in My videos and download the MP4 before its expiry time.
dance.q2: Can I use my own cats, dogs or photos of people?
dance.a2: Each photo defines one subject; the template supplies the performance. You can use photos of people or pets, and the sample shows fictional cat and dog characters. Results can vary by subject. Use clear photos and check the close-ups and anatomy in the finished video.
dance.q3: How long can I access my photos and video?
dance.a3: File access expires 24 hours after each video task is created, not after it finishes or when you buy credits. Download before then. You can delete files earlier in My videos; task records remain in your account. Unused credits do not expire.
dance.q4: My video is stuck or failed. Should I generate again?
dance.a4: Check the existing task in My videos first. Processing or checking a task is not a confirmed failure. Generation credits are returned after a confirmed failure. If the task remains unfinished, select Get help before submitting another request. A new generation may use additional credits.

admin.metrics.title: Revenue & conversion
admin.metrics.subtitle: USD · Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8) · Calendar days including today; today is incomplete.
admin.metrics.cohort_note: Count each visit once at each step, in order, starting with its first studio view in this period. Later payment belongs to the visit date. Visits are browser flows, not unique people or all website visitors. Recent cohorts can still convert.
admin.metrics.daily_conversion: Daily cohorts · rates always show their denominators
admin.metrics.branch_note: Checkout rate independently pairs server-confirmed payments with checkout orders in the same flow, grouped by its first checkout date. Delivery pairs successful jobs with submitted jobs by task ID and submission date, including existing credit holders. Missing tracking or cross-device visits can undercount conversion. — means no denominator.
admin.metrics.unavailable: Revenue report unavailable. No zero values have been substituted.
admin.metrics.profit_note: Receipts minus recorded Kie usage is an API contribution estimate, not final net profit: payment fees, refunds, taxes and other expenses are not deducted. Purchases prepay credits; unused credits may incur future costs.
admin.metrics.cost_note: Kie usage comes from reported task consumption at the existing $0.005/credit rate (rounded up per task), not top-ups or a resolution price estimate. Costs are attributed to task creation date, including real test/failed/deleted tasks. Bonus-credit discounts, calls outside this app and unrecorded retries are not covered.
admin.metrics.incomplete: Some costs or payment amounts are missing. Margin stays blank until records are complete; known cost is only a subtotal.

dance.headline: Smalltown Boy AI Dance Video Generator
dance.trend.title: What is the Smalltown Boy AI dance trend?
dance.trend.body: The Smalltown Boy AI dance trend turns a dramatic duo performance into a personalized video: one character reacts close to the camera while a partner dances behind, before they dance together. Cat remixes use the same visual joke with animated pets. The name comes from Bronski Beat’s “Smalltown Boy.”
dance.trend.version_title: Find the version you actually want
dance.trend.version_body: The song also appears in parents’ 80s dance clips and other edits. This template uses a 14-second duo performance, not every version of the challenge. Compare the opening reaction, partner dance and ending with the sample before uploading.
dance.trend.sample_body: The sample features fictional cat and dog characters. Its original soundtrack was added after generation. Your delivery uses generated audio, which may differ. Faces, paws, clothing and timing can vary; a new generation is a new take, not a guaranteed identical copy.
dance.cta.title: Ready to put your duo in the dance?
dance.cta.body: Watch the sample, pick your two photos, and make your version of the Smalltown Boy dance.
dance.q8: What is the video where two cats scream and then dance?
dance.a8: If you mean a dramatic close-up with another cat dancing behind, followed by a duo dance, you may be looking for the Smalltown Boy AI dance trend. Several versions use the same song, so compare the scene and movements with the sample rather than the name alone.
dance.q9: Do I need a prompt or a reference video?
dance.a9: No. This fixed template supplies the reference performance, so you only provide the two role photos and choose an available resolution. There is no prompt to write or reference clip to upload. Watch the sample first: the template does not offer custom choreography.
dance.q10: Is a Smalltown Boy CapCut template the same as this AI dance?
dance.a10: Not necessarily. Templates can share the song name but use different clips or effects. Check whether the preview shows the duo you want, whether it needs photos or filmed clips, and whether it generates new motion. This tool uses two photos and a fixed dance reference.
dance.q11: Can I generate the video for free?
dance.a11: Watching the sample is free. Generating a personalized video requires credits. Check your balance and the displayed credit cost before starting; if your balance is insufficient, purchase a one-time pack.
dance.q12: How much does a video cost? Is there a subscription?
dance.a12: The single pack costs ${price} USD and covers one 720p generation ({credits} credits). Larger packs cover 3 or 5 generations at 720p. Pay once, with no subscription. Other resolutions use different credit amounts.
dance.q13: How long is the video, and which part of the dance does it use?
dance.a13: Smalltown Boy AI creates a 14-second, vertical 9:16 video. It follows the opening reaction, partner dance and ending shown in the sample. Other templates may use longer sequences or different cuts; do not assume every Smalltown Boy video contains the same shots.
dance.q14: Will my face or my pet’s appearance stay exactly the same?
dance.a14: An exact match in every frame is not guaranteed. Use a sharp photo with even lighting and no face covering or heavy filters. Check faces, fur markings, hands and paws during close-ups and fast movement. Higher resolution alone does not guarantee better identity consistency.
dance.q15: Can I play both roles with the same photo?
dance.a15: Both photo slots must be filled. The same subject in both roles has not been separately verified, so do not assume it will produce two consistent copies. Two distinct, clear subject photos make the intended role assignment easier to review.
dance.q16: How long does generation take? Can I close the page?
dance.a16: Generation time varies with the provider and queue. Track the existing task in My videos instead of starting another one. You can return to the same account to check progress. The 24-hour file-access window starts when the video task is created, so download promptly once the result is ready.
dance.preview.question: Can I purchase or generate a video on this site yet?
dance.preview.answer: Not yet. This is a display preview: you can watch the sample and explore the photo roles, but accounts, purchases and generation are not open. The pricing and workflow below describe the planned service, not an available purchase.
dance.q17: Can I download an MP4 without a watermark?
dance.a17: Completed videos are available as MP4 downloads in My videos. We deliver the provider’s generated file. We do not guarantee watermark-free output. Review the downloaded file before posting, and save it before the video task’s file-access deadline.
